config.description: Soft mask + periodic state reset at 10,000 instead of 4,000 -- the clean next step of the reset-period sweep, with chunk_len held at 2,000.
config.hypothesis:
We have contradictory evidence on the reset period. dozken's reset2k outscores their reset4k, implying shorter is better; our own v012 found 2,000 WORSE than 4,000, implying longer is better. v012 is confounded -- reaching a 2,000-row horizon required chunk_len 1,000, so it changed the BPTT granularity as well as the period.
This run removes the confound by holding chunk_len at 2,000 and moving only the period. The trainer requires state_reset to divide 20,000 AND be a multiple of chunk_len with k >= 2, so at chunk_len 2,000 the reachable periods are exactly 4,000 / 10,000 / 20,000: 6,000 is not merely inadvisable, it is unreachable. 10,000 is therefore the only clean step upward, and it is a large one -- two segments per sequence instead of five.
If 10,000 beats 4,000 the lever is real and was under-set, and 20,000 (a single segment, i.e. no reset at all) becomes the next test. If 10,000 is worse, 4,000 is near-optimal and the lever is spent at our sequence length.
config.change_vs_parent:
EXACTLY ONE change off gru_v011: training.state_reset and inference.state_reset 4000 -> 10000. chunk_len stays at 2,000, which is what makes this clean -- v012 had to drop chunk_len to 1,000 to reach a 2,000-row horizon and so moved two things at once.
Unchanged: the soft mask (loss.mask_model), architecture 2x128 proj0 (192,258 params), seed 1337, 3-epoch cosine schedule, aux weighted-MSE 0.05, EMA 0.999.

train_time_metrics.aggregation: mean of two target-wise global clipped Weighted Pearson correlations over all masked rows
